description: Version 1 tenant inventory, usage, and product reporting contract. Tenant panels require the pending PostgreSQL reporting views; only the fleet aggregate panel is live today.

panels.description: The current branch has no durable tenancy database or inventory scanner.

options.content:
## Pending durable tenant source
The invited/active/disabled, inventory, usage, and product panels below query versioned `reporting.*_v1` PostgreSQL views that are **not implemented today**. No tenant values are inferred from OTel. The only live panel is the explicitly fleet-wide request aggregate. A future `single_owner_filesystem` inventory source is temporary migration metadata, not a tenant boundary; no scanner exists on this branch.

panels.title: Implementation status

panels.description: PENDING: reporting.admin_tenant_state_counts_v1. Authoritative application state, not an OTel metric.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tenant_count AS value FROM reporting.admin_tenant_state_counts_v1 WHERE tenant_state = 'invited'

panels.title: Invited tenants (pending)

panels.description: PENDING: reporting.admin_tenant_state_counts_v1. Authoritative application state, not an OTel metric.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tenant_count AS value FROM reporting.admin_tenant_state_counts_v1 WHERE tenant_state = 'active'

panels.title: Active tenants (pending)

panels.description: PENDING: reporting.admin_tenant_state_counts_v1. Authoritative application state, not an OTel metric.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tenant_count AS value FROM reporting.admin_tenant_state_counts_v1 WHERE tenant_state = 'disabled'

panels.title: Disabled tenants (pending)

panels.description: LIVE NOW: anonymous fleet aggregate only. This is not an authoritative tenant usage count.
panels.title: Fleet request rate (live)

panels.description: PENDING: latest durable inventory snapshot per opaque tenant_ref. source=single_owner_filesystem is temporary and must never be presented as multi-tenant isolation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tenant_ref AS "Tenant", tenant_state AS "State", inventory_source AS "Source", inventory_complete AS "Complete", captured_at AS "Captured", runtime_count AS "Runtimes", runtime_bytes AS "Runtime bytes", runtime_file_count AS "Runtime files", session_count AS "Sessions", session_bytes AS "Session bytes", session_file_count AS "Session files", memory_count AS "Memories", memory_bytes AS "Memory bytes", memory_file_count AS "Memory files", workspace_count AS "Workspaces", workspace_bytes AS "Workspace bytes", workspace_file_count AS "Workspace files" FROM reporting.admin_tenant_inventory_latest_v1 WHERE tenant_ref = ${tenant_ref:sqlstring}

panels.title: Per-tenant runtime, session, memory, and workspace inventory (pending)

panels.description: PENDING: authoritative hourly usage rollup for the selected opaque tenant_ref.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, turns, failed_turns, rejected_turns FROM reporting.admin_tenant_usage_hourly_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND tenant_ref = ${tenant_ref:sqlstring} ORDER BY bucket_start

panels.title: Turns and errors over time (pending)

panels.description: PENDING: authoritative token totals, never derived from sampled traces.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, input_tokens, output_tokens FROM reporting.admin_tenant_usage_hourly_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND tenant_ref = ${tenant_ref:sqlstring} ORDER BY bucket_start

panels.title: Tokens over time (pending)

panels.description: PENDING: per-hour p50/p95 turn latency from durable rollups.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, turn_latency_p50_ms, turn_latency_p95_ms FROM reporting.admin_tenant_usage_hourly_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND tenant_ref = ${tenant_ref:sqlstring} ORDER BY bucket_start

panels.title: Turn latency (pending)

panels.description: PENDING: per-hour queue wait distribution from durable rollups.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, queue_wait_p50_ms, queue_wait_p95_ms FROM reporting.admin_tenant_usage_hourly_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND tenant_ref = ${tenant_ref:sqlstring} ORDER BY bucket_start

panels.title: Queue wait (pending)

panels.description: PENDING: queued and queue-rejected turns from authoritative hourly usage rollups.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, queued_turns, queue_rejected_turns FROM reporting.admin_tenant_usage_hourly_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND tenant_ref = ${tenant_ref:sqlstring} ORDER BY bucket_start

panels.title: Queue usage (pending)

panels.description: PENDING: content-free memory search counts from the authoritative hourly rollup.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, searches, failed_searches, result_count FROM reporting.admin_tenant_memory_search_hourly_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND tenant_ref = ${tenant_ref:sqlstring} ORDER BY bucket_start

panels.title: Memory search usage (pending)

panels.description: PENDING: reviewed, versioned product events only. No free-form properties or content.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "Day", event_name AS "Event", client_platform AS "Platform", event_count AS "Events", success_count AS "Successful" FROM reporting.admin_product_daily_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND tenant_ref = ${tenant_ref:sqlstring} ORDER BY day DESC, event_name

panels.title: Product event rollup (pending)
